answer: Yes, but only if Amudha's savings can cover about Rs. 12.4 lakh and still leave the Rs. 3 lakh buffer. If they can, the second kitchen should go in Thoraipakkam (OMR), now quoted at Rs. 48,000 a month. OMR has clear unmet demand, little competition for a home-style bakery, and a kitchen there would take most deliveries from the Rs. 180 band to under 5 km. The risk is the target: about Rs. 1.9 lakh of extra monthly revenue is roughly 165 extra orders a month at the September average order value, and OMR orders today are only about 41 a month.

findings.claim: OMR is where demand is being lost to price. 25 of 33 OMR respondents tried to order and gave up because of the Rs. 180 delivery charge.
findings.quote:
Of the 33 OMR respondents, 25 said they had tried to order but gave up because the
  delivery charge to OMR (Rs. 180) was too high.

findings.claim: There is possible corporate demand in OMR IT parks.
findings.quote:
Corporate orders came up unprompted: 11 respondents work in OMR IT parks and said their
  offices order desserts for events at least once a month.

findings.claim: A Thoraipakkam kitchen would put most OMR addresses in the cheapest delivery band. Today every OMR order is in the most expensive band.
findings.quote: From a kitchen in Thoraipakkam, most OMR addresses would be under 5 km.

findings.claim: Long-distance delivery also causes damage. 6 of the 9 damage complaints this year were on deliveries over 15 km.
findings.quote:
6 of the 9 damage complaints this year were
on deliveries over 15 km.

findings.claim: OMR competitors are cheap cloud bakeries with no eggless premium cakes, and no home-style bakery with a following is on OMR. Eggless was the most requested addition in the survey (47 respondents).
findings.quote: No home-style bakery with a following like ours has a kitchen on OMR yet.

findings.claim: Velachery is crowded with well-rated bakeries, which weakens Option A despite its lower rent.
findings.quote:
In Velachery there are at least five well-rated bakeries within 3 km of the Vijaya
  Nagar space.

findings.claim: Anna Nagar West is the most expensive option and does not reach a new area. It is also the only option with a 10-month deposit.
findings.quote: Notes: easiest to manage, but it does not bring the bakery closer to any new area.

findings.claim: The Thoraipakkam rent has risen from the August quote to Rs. 48,000. The deposit is still 6 months, which is Rs. 2.88 lakh.
findings.quote:
the rent for the OMR space is now Rs. 48,000 per month, not the 45,000 in
   your August quote. The deposit is still 6 months.

findings.claim: Setup costs about Rs. 6.5 lakh. With the deposit that is about Rs. 9.4 lakh upfront, plus the Rs. 3 lakh buffer the accountant wants kept.
findings.quote: Setting up any of the three spaces will cost about Rs. 6.5 lakh

findings.claim: The break-even hurdle for the OMR kitchen is about Rs. 1.9 lakh of extra monthly revenue.
findings.quote:
a second kitchen needs roughly
   Rs. 1.9 lakh of extra monthly revenue to cover rent, two staff salaries and
   electricity at the OMR space.

findings.claim: The current kitchen is capacity-constrained, so there is some extra demand beyond OMR.
findings.quote:
On 14
weekends in this period, orders were turned away because the oven schedule was full.

findings.claim: OMR orders today are small, about 41 a month in September. Moving them to a nearer kitchen would not by itself reach the Rs. 1.9 lakh hurdle.
The average order value used for the break-even estimate is Rs. 1,140.
findings.quote: The average order value in September was Rs. 1,140.

conflicts: Thoraipakkam rent: rent-quotes.md (late August 2026) says Rs. 45,000 per month, while accountant-note.md (28 September 2026) says Rs. 48,000. The accountant's note is newer, so I used Rs. 48,000.
The accountant's Rs. 1.9 lakh break-even figure does not say whether it uses the old or new OMR rent. I assumed it reflects the new rent because it appears after the rent update in the same note.
not_in_documents: Amudha's current savings or bank balance, so I can't tell whether she can afford about Rs. 9.4 lakh upfront (setup plus deposit) and still keep the Rs. 3 lakh buffer.
Any updated rent quotes for Velachery or Anna Nagar West after August. The Rs. 38,000 and Rs. 52,000 figures may be out of date.

The lease length or terms, and whether the landlord will negotiate the rent or deposit.
Whether the oven capacity problem at Anna Nagar would ease once OMR orders move to the new kitchen.
